endorsements.quote: This includes implementing transparent informed consent processes that clearly outline AI’s role in patient care and uphold patient autonomy.
The successful implementation of AI-assisted clinical decision-making systems requires seamless integration with existing EHRs and clinical workflows.
Additionally, establishing comprehensive decision-tracking systems is crucial to document AI-assisted decisions, ensuring accountability and traceability.
Moreover, transparent communication regarding AI system functions, limitations, and decision-making principles is vital.
Moreover, improving algorithm interpretability and transparency is vital to facilitate clinical trust and acceptance.

unlisted_practices: Provide comprehensive, role-specific training programs and continuous professional development for healthcare providers on engaging with AI systems.
Develop AI models tailored to elderly populations using specialized databases reflecting their clinical complexity and regional variations.
Conduct thorough cost-effectiveness analyses of the initial and ongoing investments in AI deployment and its potential savings.
Implement change management strategies to overcome healthcare professionals' resistance to AI technologies.
Validate AI recommendations through demonstrable clinical outcomes to foster trust.
Establish robust evaluation frameworks to assess AI's short- and long-term impacts on patient outcomes, clinician satisfaction, and system efficiency.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/commentary article discussing the deployment and governance of AI in clinical decision support for elderly diabetes care rather than an empirical study.
